rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard RVE homogenization approach with periodic boundary conditions, but its implementation requires careful handling of random pore placement drawn from an experimental size distribution, plane-stress elasticity, and volume-averaged stress/strain computation. It goes beyond a textbook operation and involves several interacting components.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating multiple random RVE geometries (15 runs for 5 porosities × 3 realizations), meshing, applying periodic constraints, solving linear elasticity, and averaging homogenized moduli. While each step is manageable, orchestrating them correctly with an open-source FE solver (e.g., FEniCS) and ensuring non-overlapping pores requires non-trivial scripting and error handling.
